morphology.compounding_rule: Norse dithematic ([quality|animal|resource](stem) + element: Jarn-borg, iron-fort; Silki-vik, silk-bay) fused to Sinitic quality+type heads (Jin-cheng, golden-city; Da-jiang, great-river): the capital Seres-vik (the silk-trade bay), Jarn-cheng (the iron-walled city), Silki-jiang (the silk-river).
morphology.patronymic_form: the Norse ruling stock keep the -son / -dottir patronymic and an aett (lineage) name; the Sinitic populace keep the clan-surname (xing) first, then the given name (ming), with generation-names within a zu; the throne fuses both - a konungr who carries both a -son patronymic and a granted xing of the Mandate-court.

patterns.dungeons_ruins: sunken river-borgs and fallen warlord cheng: 'the Borg of [name]', 'the Howe of the Jarls', 'the Ruined Cheng of [warlord]', 'the Drowned Kaupang'
patterns.military_units: the konungr's hird (war-band) and the felag (the sworn trade-and-war company), plus the Sinitic Ying (camp/army) and the colored Banner: 'the Hird of Seresmark', 'the Silk-felag', 'the Azure Banner of the cheng'
patterns.ships: river-keels and silk-traders, named in Norse kennings: 'the Silk-Serpent', 'the Wave-Stallion', 'Raven of the Jiang', 'Pride of the Vik'
patterns.taverns: 'The [Adjective] [Noun]': 'The Jade Cup', 'The Silk and Salt', 'The Far-Sailed Raven'

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - Norse reflexes PRIMARY (family_germanic theonym_ancestors, the norse column), Sinitic variants SECONDARY (family_east_asian theonym_sets.sinitic, rendered in the jinxian -di/-jun celestial register), never real Norse/Chinese gods. The Norse far-traders keep their oath-and-war powers; the conquered silk-empire keeps its Celestial Bureaucracy under the Mandate of Heaven, and the two are quietly identified (one power, two faces). Alignment PROVISIONAL (Lawful/Neutral): the Norse oath-and-trade felag meets the Sinitic Mandate-of-Heaven law-court.
religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the Chaotic powers, warded as fjandr (Norse foes) or mo (Sinitic demon-marshals), keep their morphs + an epithet: Maraxus -> Marhr the War-Brand (Sinitic Maluo the War-Fire Marshal); Vacidus -> Vakr the Unmaker (Sinitic Wuci the Devourer); Lusanto -> Lusandr the Hoard-Worm (Sinitic Lusan the Coin-Serpent).

holy_symbol_motifs.Geyandr: the green mountain over the grain-altar
holy_symbol_motifs.Orlund: an iron sword crossed with a war-keel's prow
holy_symbol_motifs.Thulr: a sun-disc over a crossed sword and the seal of office

religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Hof (Norse temple) or Miao (Sinitic temple) of [power]: 'the Hof of Thulr', 'the Miao of Tuli-di'; the ancestral Ci (Sinitic clan-shrine) for the zu.
religion.saints_pattern: the deified war-dead and konungar of the Norse aett, honored at the haugr (howe) and the hof; and the worthy officials and heroes of the silk-empire enrolled in the celestial register, honored at the Ci (ancestral shrine) and the Miao.

religion.the_one: Eitnir (Norse; Sinitic Aiteng) - the distant Ancient One, the Highest Heaven, honored not petitioned

worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: Venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon, and names the Lawful powers - and Eitnir - as the tyrant-gods to be defied.
worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates the Lawful powers - Eitnir foremost, Thulr the just, Orlund of the sworn war, Rjalta the merciful - and names the Chaotic powers fjandr (foes/devils) or the Sinitic mo (demon-marshals), warded and unworshipped; the felag-oath, the just konungr and the Mandate-throne are the social ideal
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: the ancestral war-dead (the Norse aett-forebears and the deified konungar) and the Sinitic ancestors (the zu) and local earth-and-grain powers; the great powers invoked at the hof and the miao situationally rather than worshipped wholesale

titles._tiers_note: Norse ladder, ascending, with the Sinitic mandarin co-titles beneath. Hersir (war-chieftain, local lord) barony over a Herad (district); Mark-jarl (march-jarl) march over the Mork (border-march); Lendr-madr (the landed king's-man) county over a Len (granted fief); Jarl (earl/great-lord) duchy over a Jarldom; Fylkir (folk-king, host-leader) principality over a Fylki; Konungr (king) kingdom over a Konungriki; Allra-Konungr (the king-of-all, the high-konungr who holds the Mandate-throne) empire over the Stor-riki (the 'great realm'). The conquered silk-empire keeps its Sinitic Wang (king-of-the-old-line, now a vassal-prince) and the five peerages Gong > Hou > Bo > Nan beneath the Norse crown, plus the Dudu frontier-commanders and the Confucian officials who run the cheng-cities. The gothi (Norse priest) and the Sinitic Daoshi stand outside the ladder. Rank titles fuse the real Old Norse and Chinese registers (allowed).
titles.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH (or an approved commonly-known foreign term where set in 'ruler'). The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.
titles.government: feudal (a Norse far-trader aristocracy over the Sinitic silk-empire: the konungr and his jarl-kin at the Mandate-throne, the jarls and hersar over the river-cheng, the felag-sworn huskarlar of the war-band; the Sinitic mandarinate - the wang, the five peerages and the Confucian officials - serve beneath and run the cheng-cities and the silk-revenues)
titles.heir: Konungs-son (the king's son; the heir; the Sinitic court calls him Taizi, the crown-prince)

honorifics.elder: Eldri (the elder) / the Bixia at the Mandate-throne

vassalage.fealty: Eidr (the sworn oath) / Mengyue (Sinitic sworn covenant)
